name: Domes Miramare Corfu
positioning: Domes Miramare, a Luxury Collection Resort, Corfu: an adults-only beach resort on Miramare Beach in Moraitika, in a building once owned by the Onassis family
best_for: Adult couples who want a beachfront stay with olive groves and sea access
Travelers who want a suite or villa with a private garden and pool

facts.text: The resort is on Miramare Beach in Moraitika, Corfu, Greece.
The building was designed by Charalambos Sfaellos and was once owned by the Onassis family.
In the 1960s Miramare was a summer getaway for international jet setters, including Onassis, Maria Kallas and royalty.
Arches on the facade are the signature of the main building.
The grounds have century-old olive groves and gardens, with walks along the shoreline.
The suites use materials such as fine wood, glass and marble.
The Emerald Residences have a dining area and a fully equipped kitchenette.
Water activities include glass-bottom canoeing, water biking, stand-up paddleboarding and wakeboarding.
The gym extends outdoors onto a waterfront lawn, which the hotel describes as ideal for aqua yoga and sunrise meditation sessions.
The resort has a private tennis court.
A pianist performs live in the lobby.
1962 Restaurant by the sea serves a seasonally driven a la carte Greek-Med menu of fresh seafood and organic vegetable dishes for lunch and dinner.

highlights.text: Pavilion Suites in the seafront wing have large private gardens with a wooden deck, a private swimming pool, an outdoor Jacuzzi and an outdoor shower.
The HRH Villas are in the secluded Ultra Exclusive Area of the seafront wing, with direct access to the sea.
SOMA Spa resembles an ancient Greek bath, with marble and arches, and has a large indoor pool area and four treatment rooms.
Haute Living Selection guests get a dedicated HLS Manager, upgraded amenities, an exclusive check-in, a pillow menu and concierge services.
On the private beach, sun loungers have call buttons that summon the beach bar's service.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
Haute Living Selection privileges require booking one of the HLS accommodation options.
Corfu International Airport is approximately 18.4 km from the hotel.
